summary: First full E2E test of the ADHD Day Planner MVP. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passing — health, all auth negatives, CORS, seeded-session auth (synthetic user/session in MongoDB), tasks CRUD, recurring vs one-time visibility, complete/uncomplete, and Claude-powered daily-content generation + caching. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667): login screen renders with all testIDs (login-screen, login-google-button, login-logo, login-tag, login-title, login-subtitle), unauthenticated route gating works (/(tabs) redirects to /login), no JS errors. Only console noise: React Native web 'shadow*' deprecation warnings (tasks.tsx:414-417).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props produce console warnings on web ('shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/tasks.tsx:414-417 (shadowColor, shadowOpacity, shadowRadius, shadowOffset).

action_items: Migrate 'shadow*' style props in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/tasks.tsx (lines 414-417) to the new 'boxShadow' shorthand to silence React Native web deprecation warnings (cosmetic only — does not break functionality).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is well-structured: timezone-aware datetime helpers, Mongo _id excluded everywhere, /api prefix enforced, proper Pydantic validation, indexes created on startup, expired session check correct.
auth_helper correctly raises 401 for missing/expired/invalid tokens; complete/uncomplete endpoints idempotent via upsert.
Daily-content endpoint correctly uses cache-first pattern with race-condition fallback; LLM JSON parsing tolerates fenced code blocks.
Frontend route gating works via index.tsx redirect based on AuthContext state — verified that direct /(tabs) navigation while unauthenticated is bounced to /login.
seed_data_creation: Synthetic user + user_sessions documents are created and torn down per-test by the 'seeded_user' fixture in conftest.py. All test docs prefixed TEST_ for safe identification. No persistent test data left in MongoDB after the suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/. They use a pymongo fixture that inserts a fake user + session_token directly into Mongo to bypass the Emergent Google OAuth UI. Reuse the 'seeded_user' / 'auth_headers' fixtures for any authenticated endpoint tests. Daily-content test uses a unique 2099-XX-XX date to force live LLM generation; it takes ~5s. Frontend OAuth callback cannot be exercised in the web preview (deep-link), but the login UI and route gating are testable.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. The only finding is a cosmetic React Native web warning from deprecated shadow* style props in tasks.tsx; replace with boxShadow per RN 0.76+ guidance.
